arithmeticChecks.method: Python Decimal arithmetic with ROUND_HALF_UP for modeled per-fee cent rounding; source fee ledger remains authoritative.
arithmeticChecks.bookingExample: 45-minute appointment starting 11:00 ends 11:45; 15-minute after-buffer ends at 12:00. An 11:45 appointment-availability end prevents the buffer overrunning the noon work limit.
arithmeticChecks.welcomeSequence: Two days after email 1, then three days after email 2: approximately five days from entry to final message, subject to actual configured timing.
